scope: From the seat of the person carrying on an enterprise (the platform rider; the founder and his company). The meaning of enterprise worked out from facts through s 41 and GST Act s 9-20, with its exclusions (employees and withholding payments, hobbies, no expectation of profit for individuals and partnerships, local councillors) and s 5A (religious practitioners); carrying on, including start-up and wind-up (s 41); entitlement to an ABN (s 8), including Corporations Act companies and limited registration entities; applying in the approved form, the TFN not compelled, when the Registrar must register you, backdated effect (ss 9, 10, 11(2)); treating a 28-day silence as refusal (s 13(2)-(4)); notifying changes within 28 days and who carries that duty (ss 14, 16(1), (2)); answering the Registrar's requests with at least 14 days (s 15); cancellation, its grounds, reasons and date of effect, and reinstatement (ss 18(1)-(6), 19); reviewable ABN decisions (s 21); using a number that is not your ABN (s 23(1)). Not encoded: s 5 (government entities, super funds, RSE licensees), representatives (ss 9A, 10A, 11A, 18(1A)), changing an ABN (s 17), the register and access to it (ss 24-27, 29A), confidentiality (s 30), s 23(2)-(3), s 16(3)-(5), penalties under the Taxation Administration Act 1953 s 8C and the Part IVC objection procedure, machinery.
seat: the person carrying on an enterprise: the platform rider with an ABN; the founder, for his company
